updates.detailed_summary_zh: LayerZero今年已失去十二家合作伙伴，包括Nethermind、Kelp DAO、Kraken和BitGo，其ZRO代币下跌了三分之一。最新离开的Nethermind于本周三终止了其验证者角色，并迁移至竞争对手。 这一大规模退出表明，在Lazarus Group事件后，市场对LayerZero安全模型的信任度下降，数十亿美元桥接资产正在撤出。作为领先的互操作性平台，失去主要企业和机构用户会削弱网络效应，并可能重塑跨链桥格局。 截至7月初，已有超过70亿美元资产迁出LayerZero，BitGo的退出使累计总额接近150亿美元。7月，LayerZero宣布将停止对低活跃度链的支持，并为仍使用v1库的团队设定了8月3日的截止期限。
updates.detailed_summary_en: LayerZero has lost a dozen partnerships this year, including Nethermind, Kelp DAO, Kraken, and BitGo, as its ZRO token fell by a third. The latest departure, Nethermind, terminated its role as a verifier on Wednesday and migrated to a competitor. This exodus signals declining trust in LayerZero's security model after the Lazarus Group incident, with billions in bridged assets moving off the protocol. As a leading interoperability platform, losing major enterprise and institutional users erodes network effects and could reshape the cross-chain bridge landscape. By early July, more than $7 billion in assets had already migrated off LayerZero, and BitGo's exit pushed the cumulative total toward $15 billion. In July, LayerZero announced it was winding down support for low-activity chains and set an August 3 deadline for teams still using v1 libraries.
